question: Where can I find a hotel bounded by 170 kilometers distance toward the north of Mercy Hospital, Moose Lake, MN?
sql: WITH hospital_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mercy Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Moose Lake%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MN%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM hospital_location)::geography, 170000) AND ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) > ST_Y(ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM hospital_location))) ;
